name: Viersche
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game where teams race to take 100 of 140 card points to erase rungs of a chalk ladder.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships opposite each other, 36 cards (A K Q J 10 9 8 7). Deal 9 each anticlockwise in threes. A trump suit is determined each deal: forehand must lead a trump if possible, otherwise leads face-down as trump; highest trump wins. Jack of trumps (Alt) is highest trump, Jack of same colour (Kloei) second-highest; both worth 12 points. Other Jacks 2, A 11, K 4, Q 3, Ten 10, rest 0, total 140. Subsequent tricks: must follow suit or trump if able, otherwise any card; highest trump wins or highest of led suit. After deal, team with 100+ card points wins 1 game point; 9 tricks wins 2. If neither reaches 100 in one deal, totals are carried and another deal played until a team reaches 100. First to 4 game points erases the ladder and wins; losers receive penalty marks.
